verdict.rationale: mise documents committing a lockfile and running `mise install --locked` so that every job installs the same versions [mise-docs-70, mise-docs-95]. It also provides a `mise lock` command [mise-docs-35] and a `--pin` option that writes resolved versions into config [mise-docs-85], which together deliver exact-version reproducibility across machines for the tools it manages. Missing for 10: detail in the pack on lockfile contents (per-platform checksums/URLs and how resolution is recorded), and independent or hands-on confirmation that `--locked` installs are identical across machines and OSes.
